scripts.name: wt-battwatch
scripts.description: buzz and notify when charge crosses a threshold.

scripts.name: wt-clipopen
scripts.description: hand whatever is on the clipboard to the system as a uri.

scripts.name: wt-pomodoro
scripts.description: work/break cycles, each end marked by a buzz and a notification.

scripts.name: wt-remind
scripts.description: notification after a delay, without keeping a screen on.

scripts.name: wt-sensorlog
scripts.description: sample one sensor on an interval into a csv.

scripts.name: wt-status
scripts.description: one screen of watch state: battery, network, storage.
scripts.usage: wt-status [-n]  (-n also posts the summary as a notification)

scripts.name: wt-timer
scripts.description: countdown on the wrist. Vibrates and speaks when it runs out.
scripts.usage: wt-timer 5m tea  (suffix s, m or h; bare number means seconds)
